needed.evidence: The right side consists of an informal path heavily blocked by market stalls and goods, forcing pedestrians into the road.
needed.suggestion: Construct a dedicated, wide sidewalk on the right side to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

needed.evidence: Market stalls and produce carts completely block the walking area on the right.
needed.suggestion: Implement regulations to ensure market stalls do not obstruct the pedestrian footway.

needed.evidence: The sidewalk on the left is uneven and broken in several places.
needed.suggestion: Repair and resurface the sidewalk on the left to remove trip hazards.

needed.evidence: There is high pedestrian demand due to shops on both sides, but no designated crossing facility is provided.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked zebra crossing to provide pedestrians with a safe place to cross the street.

needed.evidence: No street lighting poles are visible along this urban commercial stretch.
needed.suggestion: Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians at night.
